|game_text=Deploy on a site with “Waters” in game text. During your battle phase, if on [[Jabba's Palace: Rancor Pit{{!}}Rancor Pit]], may relocate a captive from [[Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber{{!}}Audience Chamber]] to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. May use 1 Force to ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|hatnote=For the later errata texts, see [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata)]] and [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 2)]].
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata versions are [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). The image here is the Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-32-Dark_Waters_Krayt_Dragon_Bones.png]]), which shows this text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-darkwaters&kraytdragonbones-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E1 text (see [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata)]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet, first copy (official text as of 4 September 2009)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref>, and in the revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010; slip [[:File:VB6-32-Dark_Waters_Krayt_Dragon_Bones.png]])<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a site with “Waters” in game text. During your battle phase, if on Rancor Pit, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. May use 1 Force to ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata)]]): deploys on Rancor Pit, “if you have no presence here”, and the ▼ no longer costs 1 Force: “Deploy on Rancor Pit. During your battle phase, if you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. (Immune to Alter.)” Announced in the Players Committee news post “Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes” (23 July 2010)<ref name="src-S4">Players Committee news post "Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes", 23 July 2010. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100820023348/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-darkwaters&kraytdragonbones-pre.gif]]) prints it. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) reprints this text. That copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 2)]]): the creature sentence moves to the front: “Deploy on Rancor Pit. May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. During your battle phase, if you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. (Immune to Alter.)” Shown on the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1261_33-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>, which drops the ▼ (“May deploy a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here.”); the dropped icon is restored here as on the slips (icon notation alone is not a version, but the reorder is). No published card image prints this text; the image on [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 2)]] is a CardMaker recreation.
